description: Call before any send_email, reply, forward or create_draft tool of any server (Gmail, Outlook or another mail tool), on every email you send or draft for the signed-in person. Returns their saved signature as html and text: append it after the body. Do not write your own sign-off or signature block, and do not type contact details yourself. sender holds the same details as fields. For the sender's own details anywhere in the email (name, title, phone, email, links), use only the values in sender; if one is missing, leave it out and say so - never guess. Fetch it for each email; do not cache it. mode "short": name, role line and one link. Free plan: 50 calls a month; Company: unlimited. signature: "me" (default) or one of their AI agents from list_signatures; if it is unclear which the person wants for this email, ask before sending. To change the signature, use update_my_signature. Parts the company controls are listed in companyControlled, with who changes them in howToChange; tell the person.

signature.description: "me" (default), or an agent's id or name from list_signatures.

name: get_signature
title: Get my saved signature
